name: debugany
description: Application observability, error tracking, and debugging platform

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:sdk
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @debugany/api && npm run test --workspace @debugany/sdk
scripts.check:repo: node -e "const p = require('./package.json'); if (!p.workspaces.includes('apps/api') || !p.workspaces.includes('apps/web')) process.exit(1); console.log('Debugany workspaces are configured.')"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:sdk
